name: Chroma key
description: Removes a green screen or any colour you pick
author: Uncut

color.description: Key colour: the colour made transparent

tolerance.description: Tolerance: how far (in chroma) from the key colour is still keyed out

softness.description: Softness: how wide the blend from keyed out to kept is

spill.description: Spill removal: pulls the key colour's cast off the edges (green or blue keys)
